name: network
lead: An experience made of more than one server: asks for instances of its members and is told about them. A failed call answers nil and a reason. Calls yield, but for `status`. Without a network every answer is no.

functions.name: start
functions.signature: network.start(options: {member: string, label: string, slots: number, data: any }) → (NetworkStarted ?, string ?)
functions.description: Starts an instance of `member`. Answers at once; it is online later.

functions.name: find
functions.signature: network.find(options: {label: string, players: number ?, party: (Player | string)?, start: {member: string, slots: number, data: any }?}) → (NetworkStarted ?, string ?)
functions.description: The instance to send `players` players to (1 unless set), or nil when none has room. With `start`, one is started when none has room.

functions.name: list
functions.description: The network's instances, or only those with `label`.

functions.name: stop
functions.description: Stops an instance of this network.

functions.name: info
functions.signature: network.info() → ({network: string, id: string ?, member: string ?, label: string ?, slots: number ?, data: any }?, string ?)
functions.description: This server's network, by name, and the instance this pack runs on: `id` and the fields after it are nil on a server that is not one.

functions.name: status
functions.signature: network.status(options: {open: number, status: string ?, meta: any })
functions.description: Says where this instance is. At most one a second is sent: the first at once, then the last of those that came after.

functions.name: on_instance
functions.description: Called when an instance starts or changes.

functions.name: on_gone
functions.description: Called with the id of an instance that is gone.
